verdict.rationale: Evidence shows n8n workflows can incorporate custom code and npm packages, and community members describe it as 'easily extendable' with new integrations built easily, implying support for third-party/community components, but there is no explicit documentation of an official 'community nodes' installation mechanism or marketplace for vendor-external nodes. missing for 10: explicit docs on installing/using community-contributed nodes (e.g., npm-based community node packages), a community-nodes marketplace page, and independent confirmation of the install workflow.
